neighbours.label: something becoming possible to make out: recognizable / intelligible / discernible shapes, forms and sounds emerging from a blur ('recognizable forms appear', 'distinguish the form of')
fire: After a few weeks the toddler's scrawls became recognizable letters.
Through the mist she could just discern the outline of a tower.
The static faded and the voice grew into intelligible speech.
Gradually the blots on the paper resolved into recognizable faces.
In the dim light he could distinguish the form of a man by the door.
The restorer cleaned the canvas until recognizable figures emerged.
The noise on the tape slowly turned into intelligible sentences.
As the telescope focused, the smudge took a recognizable shape.
quiet: After a few weeks the toddler's toys became scattered everywhere.
Through the mist she could just feel the chill of the morning.
The static faded and the room fell into complete silence.
Gradually the stains on the paper dried into brown patches.
In the dim light he could smell the smoke of a fire by the door.
The restorer cleaned the canvas until bright colours emerged.
The noise on the tape slowly turned into a steady hum.
As the telescope moved, the smudge slid out of view.

notes: The top examples also include numpy .reshape(...) calls and code indentation, which this label does not cover (reshape scored 0.24 in a probe).
